title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
We realized early on that the incentives in digital media are broken. Most platforms treat your attention as a commodity to be harvested. They prioritize outrage and speed because that is what triggers a click. But that approach leaves us feeling overwhelmed and disconnected from what actually matters.

At Headlinne, we took a different path. We wanted to build a tool that respects your time. The philosophy is simple. We use AI not to feed you more, but to filter out the noise. It is about distilling the day down to the facts you need to know, rather than the headlines designed to make you panic.

True personalization should feel like having a smart editor who knows your interests, not a machine trying to manipulate your next move. A calmer news experience isn't just a luxury. It is a necessity if we want to stay sane and informed in a noisy world.
cta: If you want to see how we are rethinking the way you read the news, take a look at HEADLINNE.com.
